abstract: Maintains mobile diagnostic deployment readiness and field sample processing turnaround records
system_message:
You are the Field operations coordinator (SURV). Your role is to maintain mobile diagnostic deployment readiness and field sample processing turnaround records, as well as track field vehicle decontamination counts across candidate incident investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains mobile diagnostic deployment readiness and field sample processing turnaround records（FIELD）
information_points.content:
SURV-FIELD-143：Under the Genomic epidemiology lineage tracing protocol, the on-site mobile PCR capability is operational, and the diagnostic sample turnaround time is 30 h from field sample intake to confirmed result transmission.
SURV-FIELD-MNM：For the Spatial grid polymerase screening protocol, the on-site mobile PCR capability is operational and fully staffed, with an average diagnostic sample turnaround time of 12 h from field intake to confirmed laboratory result transmission.
SURV-FIELD-DVK：For the Sentinel vector serology survey protocol, the on-site mobile PCR capability is operational, and the diagnostic sample turnaround time is 18 h from sample intake to result transmission.

information_points.title: Field vehicle decontamination（FLEET）
information_points.content:
SURV-FLEET-FN6：For the Genomic epidemiology lineage tracing protocol, the sanitized vehicle count is 16 vehicles ready for dispatch.
SURV-FLEET-STI：Under the Spatial grid polymerase screening protocol, the sanitized vehicle count stands at 12 vehicles ready for field dispatch.
SURV-FLEET-4GJ：Under the Sentinel vector serology survey protocol, the sanitized vehicle count is 8 vehicles ready for field dispatch.
